source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Topic 5.5.1.4 (PDF 147, printed 144).

blocks.text: Scatterplots do variables ka aapas mein taluq dikhate hain. Har nuqta (point) ek observation hai, aur graph par us ki jagah dono variables ki qeematein batati hai.
Misal: Scatterplot se dekha ja sakta hai ke parhai ke ghanton aur exam scores mein kya taluq hai.

blocks.alt: Scatterplot: ufuqi taraf Hours 0 se 10 aur amudi taraf scores 0 se 100. Terah nuqte 0 ghante par taqreeban 40 se 8 ghante par taqreeban 95 tak oopar jate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.7: Parhai ke ghanton aur exam scores ka rishta dikhane wala scatterplot (kitab ki Figure 5.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Nuqton ka kaunsa pattern musbat (positive) taluq dikhata hai?
blocks.explanation: Neeche baen se upar daen ki taraf barhte nuqte: ek variable barhe to doosra bhi barhta hai.

items: Scatterplot: har observation ka ek nuqta; ghante aur marks jaise taluq dikhata hai.
